probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Outkast ® Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast Menu Outkast ® Close Work Services About Careers Journal Contact Overview Buy Outkast We get your brand into print, and keep it there. Four services, run by people who used to sit on the other side of the desk. Tell us what is coming up and we will tell you which one fits, on the first call. Book a first call Media relations Pitches, follow ups, interviews Launches Embargoes, previews, press days Reputation Statements, spokespeople, crisis Founder profiles Interviews, opinion, podcasts Media relations We keep a short list of the editors and writers who cover your category, and we pitch them stories they can actually run. Every pitch is followed up by phone, and every interview is prepared the day before. Story angles each month Targeted pitching Interview prep Monthly coverage report Talk to us about media relations Launches A launch is a calendar problem. We plan the embargo, book the previews, send the samples and run the press day, so the coverage lands in the week you open and not three weeks after.
